cvStructure.issue: Your contact details list your name, email, phone and city, but there is no LinkedIn, GitHub or portfolio link, which recruiters expect for an AI/ML engineering role.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a GitHub link (or portfolio site) showing your Date-Palm classifier and Demand Forecast Service code, since these are your strongest technical projects.

cvStructure.issue: Skills currently sits after Certifications, so a recruiter scanning top to bottom reaches your technical skills late.
cvStructure.suggestion: Move Skills higher, for example: Summary, Education, Skills, Experience, Projects, Certifications, Activities, Languages.

keywordUsage.issue: The Demand Forecast Service and internship work describe forecasting weekly demand over time but never use the term that recruiters search for.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add the term "time series forecasting" to the Demand Forecast Service and/or internship entry if that is the technique you used.

keywordUsage.issue: The Date-Palm Leaf Disease Classifier describes recognising diseases from photos but does not name the task type.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add the term "image classification" to this project description so ATS systems searching for that phrase can match your CV.

readability.issue: The Summary is written in first person ("I enjoy turning messy data... and want to start my career"), which reads as a personal story rather than a professional summary.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite the Summary without "I", for example starting with "Computer Science graduate with experience in...".

readability.issue: The Demand Forecast Service project has no specific result or metric, unlike your other entries.
readability.suggestion: Add a measurable outcome, such as [response time] or [how the team used it], to show the impact of wrapping the model in FastAPI and Docker.

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are written in two different formats: "Jun 2025 - Aug 2025" for your internship versus year-only dates like "2026" and "2025" for Education, Projects, Certifications and Activities.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Pick one date format and use it everywhere, for example month and year for all entries where you know the month.
